question: Can the existing physical counter contract generate frame-order-independent, tile-exact, temporally independent and RGB-layer-independent grain innovations without static or shifted texture reuse?

primary_sources.title: AOMedia Film Grain Synthesis Technology v2
used_facts: analog RGB grain is channel independent

primary_sources.title: Recommendation ITU-T H.274 (V4)
primary_sources.used_fact: current standardized video metadata supports parameterized film-grain synthesis

controls.static_reuse: reuse frame zero for every frame
controls.shifted_reuse: circularly translate frame zero by frame-index offsets

forbidden: treat a static, toroidally shifted or interpolated prior-frame texture as temporally independent grain
claim white innovations are a complete dye-cloud, metallic-silver, density-conditioned or scanner-convolved grain model
fit on photographs or unavailable P-drive data
change seed, shape, controls or gates after formal scoring

branch_rule.pass: retain the temporal innovation primitive and compose it only through existing density/NPS physical stages in a separate leaf
branch_rule.fail: close the temporal innovation implementation without seed, threshold or cohort rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic temporal and layer independence of grain innovations only; not complete film grain, measured stock/process/scanner evidence, rendered-video quality or product readiness.
